$comment: Swift is_error_path construct table, parser pipeline §6.2. Data, not code (handoff §2). The recognizer computes which constructs a branch limb contains and looks each one up here; a limb is an error path when any present construct maps to true. Detection is from branch shape, never from naming.

catch.note: catch block. True by default; a handler that retries is arguably the happy path (parser §10). The confidence_reason records the default.

return_nil.note: return nil from an optional-returning function

early_return.note: return where the enclosing body continues below the branch point

fatal_error.note: fatalError / preconditionFailure: the limb terminates the process

guard_continue.note: the code after a guard, reached when its condition holds
